intent: Replace assembly-tolerance adjustment slots with source-selected fixed, replaceable input supports; preserve operating rail/tilt/optical controls.
audit_scope: All 151 local/world shapes, local/global placements, complete native property schemas, numeric/enumeration controls, interface/procurement metadata, group hierarchy, registries, expressions, dynamic control behavior and inventory/mass. Only two input supports may change shape; only their PrintSKU and propulsion DriveContract interface metadata may change; only two MeshClearance properties and four corresponding translation expressions may disappear.

physical_fit_limitation: Fixed holes remove the intended slide, not manufacturing clearance or tolerance. Hole clearance still permits limited pose variation, and fastener clamp friction remains necessary. Actual printed bearing/shaft fits, gear backlash, servo/horn interface, wire travel and retention require physical qualification. If mesh is unsuitable, measure and replace the complete input support with corrected fixed geometry; do not claim guaranteed interchangeability or positive locating features.

fixed_support_review.keep_separate_reason: Input support removal is needed for horn-clamp and input-bearing service; integrating it into the paired frame would obstruct those paths and enlarge the replacement scope.
fixed_support_review.horn_clamp_service: After detaching the cartridge and removing the fasteners and upper clamp half, lower the bottom half 2.5 mm then withdraw it 35 mm laterally. The former 3 mm drop catches the 64T support arm. Both gear configurations and both sides have continuous translation checks; no shape change or removed-obstacle exception is used.
fixed_support_review.service_clearance_limit: The 64T lower-half route passes a continuous distance certificate. A 141-position lateral sample measured 0.3000 mm minimum to the printed support and 0.212652 mm to all retained parts (bought horn limits the latter); samples are not a continuous minimum-clearance bound or an actual-fit guarantee.
